# Dialvo

> Dialvo is your AI sales team: agents that work every channel (voice, email, chat, social, SMS and WhatsApp) to find, engage, qualify and book, across inbound, outbound and expansion, with a human dialer for your reps.

Dialvo is in early access: teams are brought on in small groups, and channels are switched on as each account needs them. Website: https://trydialvo.com. Contact: contact@trydialvo.com.

## Channels

- Voice: AI voice agents answer and call back people who asked to hear from you (form leads, callers, existing customers who opted in), qualify them, book meetings and transfer live calls to a person. Scenarios include receptionist, speed to lead and upsell, with a choice of voice styles.
- Email: agents research each account and write one message for one person, sent from your own Gmail or Outlook inbox, and handle the replies.
- Chat: a website chat agent that answers visitors straight away and qualifies them without a form.
- Social: agents start and continue conversations on professional networks from your reps' own profiles.
- SMS and WhatsApp: follow-up by message with people who opted in.
- Human dialer: a call list for your reps, with the research brief and opening line on screen. Reps make the calls.

## Three motions

- Inbound: speed to lead within seconds, qualification against your criteria, lead routing, meeting scheduling, follow-up across channels.
- Outbound: prospect data, live signals (funding, hiring, job changes, new tools, site visits), deep research, personalised multi-channel sequences, reply handling and the human dialer.
- Expansion: upsell, cross-sell, renewal check-ins and onboarding with existing customers who opted in.

## Plays

Speed to lead, inbound qualification, meeting scheduling, outbound lead generation, lead nurture, lead reactivation, closed-lost win-back, website visitor follow-up, event follow-up and no-shows, customer expansion, customer onboarding, renewal check-ins.

## Platform

Prospect database and signals; deep research; AI personalisation; sequence builder; smart replies; knowledge base; multilingual agents; lead routing; two-way CRM sync (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho); Gmail, Outlook and Google Calendar; Slack alerts; an API; email deliverability and mailbox health; phone number health and branded caller ID; an analytics dashboard; governance (approval thresholds, escalation rules, send windows, visible agent instructions).

## Control

You can listen to every call, read every message, require approval before anything is sent, and take over any conversation.

## Trust and compliance

AI voice agents call people who asked to hear from you or opted in; Dialvo's AI does not cold call. Agents say they are an AI. Calls are recorded and transcribed, and the person is told. Opt-outs and Do Not Call lists are honoured automatically, and every email has an unsubscribe link. SMS and WhatsApp go only to people who agreed. Dialvo does not claim any certifications.

## Pricing

- Free trial: free until your first booked meeting, up to 300 AI calls, card required.
- Starter: $99 a month. Voice agent for inbound leads, email agent from your own inbox, SMS follow-up, 1,000 AI calls and 500 lead credits a month.
- Pro: $299 a month. Every channel including chat, social and WhatsApp, human dialer seats, CRM sync, premium voices, 3,000 AI calls and 1,500 lead credits a month.
- Add-ons: extra AI calls, lead credits, inboxes and dialer seats. Cancel anytime, no contract.
